title: Customers receiving incorrect items instead of their actual purchases
situation: Customers are receiving completely wrong items and demand immediate resolution before chargebacks or trust escalation occur.
hypothesis: Warehouse shipped incorrect items for recent orders

params.reply_en: We sent you the wrong item and we are sorry for this mix-up. We are arranging a free replacement for your correct order right away.
params.reply_ar: وصلك الطلب الخطأ ونعتذر عن هذا الخطأ. سنقوم بترتيب شحنة بديلة لطلبك الصحيح فوراً.

actions.why: Acknowledge the error and inform customers about the replacement.

actions.title: Wrong item received resolution
actions.answer_en: If you received the wrong item, please contact support to arrange a free replacement shipment for your correct order.
actions.answer_ar: إذا استلمت منتجاً خاطئاً، يرجى التواصل مع الدعم لترتيب شحنة بديلة مجانية لطلبك الصحيح.
